fixed_bugs.root_cause: permission enforcement only in UI; direct DAL/service calls had no boundary
fixed_bugs.fix: single AccessControl boundary in utils/security.py on existing Permission enum; fresh role read from DB per check; session denied rows audited (action=permission_denied); 21 sensitive methods guarded across 8 DALs + BackupManager

fixed_bugs.root_cause: no documented access policy for Counseling/Activities/Goals
fixed_bugs.fix: DESIGN DECISION REQUIRED registered as DD-1; no policy invented per mission item 8

fixed_bugs.root_cause: no restore method in AttachmentDAL and no UI path
fixed_bugs.fix: DAL.restore (rowcount>0 contract), get_deleted_by_entity, service.restore_attachment, checkbox+restore button in AttachmentDialog

fixed_bugs.root_cause: restore could not verify physical file (method did not exist)
fixed_bugs.fix: physical file existence verified BEFORE any DB change; missing file -> explicit ServiceError, record stays deleted

fixed_bugs.root_cause: 20-file cap only enforced at upload; interaction with restore untested
fixed_bugs.fix: cap measured including restored attachments; 20 accept / 21 reject with no DB row and no orphan file

fixed_bugs.root_cause: year combo wired to teacher-only handler; stale indicator panel kept on screen
fixed_bugs.fix: explicit on_year_changed in indicators/analysis: rebuild list for new year, clear stale panel, safe re-selection

fixed_bugs.root_cause: indicator list grades read from active profile instead of selected year
fixed_bugs.fix: profile map from selected year (new batch DAL get_by_students_and_year); year-scoped listing without fallback
same year-scoped profile map in analysis listing

fixed_bugs.root_cause: sidebar user name/icon color #08223A identical to frame background (ratio 1:1, invisible)
fixed_bugs.fix: color -> #F4C542 (contrast ~9:1); computed WCAG checks for six color pairs

fixed_bugs.root_cause: hard-coded stacked indices duplicated in menu list and two manual setCurrentIndex calls
fixed_bugs.fix: module-level PAGE_INDEX single source; menu uses page names; goto_page()/goto_page_index(); raw indices removed; regression test forbids raw setCurrentIndex
